# Hello

`custom:fluvy-hello-card` · [All cards](../cards.md#structure-and-navigation) · [Try it live](https://acosta290.github.io/fluvy/?card=hello)

The greeting: name, date, weather and avatar.

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../images/cards/hello-dark.webp"><img src="../images/cards/hello-light.webp" width="392" alt="The Hello card, drawn from the configuration below"></picture>

```yaml
type: custom:fluvy-hello-card
name: Marta
person: person.marta
weather: weather.flat
```

The picture is this configuration on the demo house, whose names and figures are made up: put your own entities in place of its. [Try it in the live demo](https://acosta290.github.io/fluvy/?card=hello), where it answers a tap as it would at home, with each of its layouts and the YAML of each.

## Options

Every key the card’s editor shows: the editor’s word for it in italics, then what it does. *Default* is what the card does when the key is left out, as the editor shows it on a new card; the editor never writes a default into the configuration.

| Key | What it does | Type | Default | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | *Name*. The name the card shows, in place of the entity’s own. | text |  |  |
| `person` | *Entity*. The person the card greets; left out, whoever is signed in. Empty: whoever is signed in. | entity (person) |  |  |
| `weather` | *Weather entity*. The weather entity whose condition and temperature the card shows. | entity (weather) |  |  |
| `show_weather` | *Show the weather*. Shows the weather beside the date. | boolean | `true` |  |
| `show_date` | *Show the date*. Shows the date. | boolean | `true` |  |
| `show_avatar` | *Show the avatar*. Shows the person’s picture. | boolean | `true` |  |
| `color` | *Colour*. The card’s colour: its circle, its accents and its tints wear it. Left out, the colour of what it shows. | colour |  |  |

**Interactions**

| Key | What it does | Type | Default | Values |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tap_action` | *Tap action*. What a tap on the card does. | action | `more-info` |  |
| `hold_action` | *Hold action*. What a long press on the card does. | action | `more-info` |  |
| `double_tap_action` | *Double tap action*. What two taps on the card do. A tap waits a moment to tell it from a double tap. | action | `none` |  |

## Older names

Names the card still reads, so a dashboard written before keeps working. They are read, never written back.

| Older name | Read as |
| --- | --- |
| `accent` | `color` |
